# Gumdoc

> Gumdoc (https://gum-doc.myshopify.com) is a small Israeli online store selling GUMDOC, a vibrating silicone gum massager for teething babies. The baby bites one soft silicone head and the device vibrates gently; vibration intensity is adjustable. It runs on 2 AA batteries (not included). GUMDOC is a comfort product for the gums only. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or medical condition and is not a substitute for medical advice; for fever, persistent crying or any concern, parents should see a pediatrician. Content is primarily in Hebrew for parents in Israel.

Key facts (as of 2026-10-19):
- Product: GUMDOC vibrating silicone gum massager (מעסה חניכיים רוטט)
- One soft silicone head; adjustable vibration intensity
- Power: 2 x AA batteries, not included
- Price: ₪129
- Shipping in Israel: ₪15; free on orders over ₪199
- Returns: return requests within 30 days of receipt (unused, original packaging, proof of purchase), per the store refund policy; Israeli consumers also have the statutory right to cancel a distance purchase within 14 days under the Consumer Protection Law, on its terms
- Safe use: baby seated, adult supervision throughout, not while walking/running, clean the head before and after each use, do not boil or microwave, stop if damaged, do not leave in the crib
- Parent video program: ₪100 back for a short public video with clear ad disclosure, first 30 qualifying parents, terms on the product page (#ugc)
- Contact: tayatanporat@gmail.com
